additionalIncome.description: The container that holds details of additional taxable income.

propertyIncomeDistributions.description: The container that holds the key value for Property Income Distributions (PIDs) from Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) and Property Authorised Investment Funds (PAIFs).

personalInsuranceBenefits.description: The container that holds the key value for personal insurance benefits.

incomeFromUnauthorisedUnitTrust.description: The container that holds the key value for income from unauthorised unit trusts.

profitsFromCertificateOfDeposit.description: The container that holds the key value for profits from certificates of deposit.

nonCashBenefitsFromFormerEmployer.description: The container that holds the key value for non-cash benefits received from a former employer.

authorisedPaymentsFromOverseasPensionSch.description: The container that holds the key value for authorised payments from overseas pension schemes.

taxableAnnualPayments.description: The container that holds the key value for taxable annual payments.

miscellaneousIncome.description: The container that holds the key value for miscellaneous income.
